copy.curiosityHook: How will three distinct visionary directors tackle speculative worlds across back-to-back animated visions?
copy.description: Three years in the making, this Japanese science-fiction anthology presents three back-to-back animated stories helmed by directors Katsuhiro Otomo, Kōji Morimoto, and Tensai Okamura.
copy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful yet exciting sci-fi animation that demands engaged attention without excessive emotional weight.
copy.whyWatch: Experience three distinct directorial perspectives exploring speculative science fiction and fantasy across a cohesive, fast-moving animated trilogy.

allowedMaterial: Directed by Katsuhiro Otomo, Kōji Morimoto, and Tensai Okamura
